title: over the hill : All 21 Vehicles | Stats & Unlock Locations (V1)
description:
Explore all 21 vehicles in Over the Hill with this quick vehicle guide featuring torque, weight, country of origin, and unlock locations—including which vehicles are available from the start.

Compare every vehicle alphabetically, from the Blast Wagon to the Woodman. Torque is displayed in lb-ft and weight in pounds for easy comparison and is the stage 3 final upgrade value.  From cars to trucks to SUVs, over the hill has it all!

Music only—no commentary.
